headline: Full-year growth accelerates, margins widen, dividend rises
summary_short: Broadridge closed fiscal 2026 with Q4 recurring revenue up 8% to $1,542M and Adjusted EPS up 8% y/y to $3.82, capping a full year of 12% Adjusted EPS growth to $9.60, a 12% dividend increase to $4.36, and new FY2027 guidance of 6-8% recurring revenue growth.
summary_long: Q4 total revenue rose 7% to $2,220M and full-year revenue grew 9% to $7,477M, driven by 8% Recurring-revenue growth from organic gains and acquisitions (Acolin, iJoin, CQG, SIS) in ICS and GTO. Q4 Adjusted Operating margin held near-flat at 26.9% as postage-driven Distribution growth offset gains elsewhere; full-year Adjusted margin was flat at 20.5%. Adjusted EPS rose 8% y/y to $3.82 in Q4 and 12% to $9.60 for FY2026, aided by a 3.9%-lower diluted share count from buybacks. Cash fell to $402.9M (from $561.5M) after $604M of buybacks and $444M of dividends; long-term debt was $3,254.6M. Broadridge raised its dividend 12% to $4.36/share and issued FY2027 guidance of 6-8% Recurring-revenue growth, 8-12% Adjusted EPS growth, and $290-330M Closed sales.

drivers.explanation: CEO Tim Gokey cited strong results from digital, agentic, and tokenized growth initiatives, record share buybacks on 110% free cash flow conversion, and a fifth consecutive three-year growth-objective cycle achieved.

Net earnings rose 6% to $398.0M and diluted share count fell to 115.6M from 118.3M a year ago on continued buybacks; GTO segment pre-tax earnings nearly doubled (+99%) on higher revenue and lower expenses.

$1,346M of operating cash flow was more than offset by $452M of investing outflows (including $283M of acquisitions) and $1,049M of financing outflows, mainly $604M of buybacks and $444M of dividends.
